name: MaskedInput
label: Masked input
description: A field that writes its value into a shape as it is typed, with a sensitive mode that hides it.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text above the field.

props.name: mask
props.description: The shape of the value: a pattern where `#` takes a digit, `A` a letter and `*` either (`'(###) ###-####'`), or a function from the raw characters to the shown text. `MASK_PRESETS` holds common patterns.

props.name: value
props.description: The raw value, the characters without the mask's separators (`"5550100199"`) (controlled). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The raw value the field starts with (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the raw value and the shown text as the reader types. Fires alongside the native `onChange`.

props.name: sensitive
props.description: Hide the value as dots until it is revealed: a tax ID, a card number. Defaults `autoComplete` to `off`.

props.name: revealable
props.description: Add a show and hide button to a sensitive field.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Whether a sensitive value is shown (controlled). Pair with `onRevealedChange`.

props.name: defaultRevealed
props.description: Whether a sensitive value starts shown (uncontrolled). Defaults to false.

props.name: onRevealedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the reader shows or hides the value, or it hides itself.

props.name: visibleTail
props.description: How many of the last characters of a hidden value stay readable while the field is not focused, so a reader can tell which card it is. Defaults to 0.

props.name: autoHideAfter
props.description: Hide a revealed value again after this many milliseconds, or after the library's reveal timeout with `true`. Off by default.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the reveal button while the value is hidden. Defaults to "Show".

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the reveal button while the value is shown. Defaults to "Hide".

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text below the field.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error message under the field; setting it marks the field invalid.

props.name: error
props.description: Error state without a message of its own.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name. The form receives the raw value through a hidden input, never the shown text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the wrapper.

Mask.description: A pattern string, or a function from the raw characters to the shown text.
